explanation.description: The explanation, one entry per sentence, in reading order.

grounding.description: question: restates information from the question stem; passages: supported by the cited passages; none: neither (own knowledge).

question_quote.description: For grounding=question: the verbatim span of the question stem that the sentence restates. Otherwise null.

passage_ids.description: Identifiers of the provided passages that support this sentence. At least one for grounding=passages; empty for grounding=none.
